title: Test the research agent’s code changes
question: Which proposal improved the validation experiment, and what remains uncertain?
summary: Round two compares two edits to the adopted L1 model. The later qualification includes a seed that regressed.

steps.title: Adopted L1 model
steps.body: Round one selected masked absolute-error training. Round two keeps the data, 40 training steps, and seed 17 fixed.

steps.title: A: zero-initialize the head
steps.body: Initialize the final convolution to zero. The residual model starts by copying the current image and then learns a correction.

steps.title: B: change sample order
steps.body: Sample a permutation without replacement instead of drawing each batch independently. Keep the inherited model and loss.

steps.title: Adopt Candidate A
steps.body: The recorded decision selects A and tests that source. A combined A+B version was not tested and is not claimed as an improvement.
